question: Are consecutive deer detections more similar than expected under independent days, and how does thinning daily visits affect fitted p and psi?

design.primary: within-site consecutive valid-day agreement (11,00,10,01), compared with within-site fixed-count random permutations of observed daily detection values, preserving each site's missing-day pattern
design.null: 1999 fixed-seed permutations of observed 0/1 within each site, NA positions unchanged, independent across sites
design.inference: two-sided exploratory Monte Carlo tail with +1 correction, not causal dependence or biological closure test
design.thinning: fit same constant-p/psi model on odd-numbered and even-numbered daily occasions separately; require >=2 observed visits per retained site; compare full 22-day fit; do not select favorable split
checks: no claim that permutation null captures closure, effort or day effects
